public_rationale: The required collapse has not been established. The records show completed investment and ongoing commercial activity. Exposure to OpenAI can inform a risk assessment, but it cannot establish the predicted consequences of a collapse that has not occurred.
limitations: Completion of an investment is not proof that SoftBank could withstand losing it.
The qualitative thresholds would require careful interpretation if the antecedent occurred.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: OpenAI's collapse would threaten SoftBank's existence and force big guidance changes at some of the largest companies in the world.

statement.excerpt: Said consequences, as I outlined in the OpenAI Bubble, are very, very serious, representing an existential threat to SoftBank, one of the largest companies on the Japanese stock market, and its collapse will guarantee massive changes to the guidance of some of the largest companies in the world.

from_speaker: its collapse will guarantee massive changes to the guidance
some of the largest companies in the world
our_interpretation: SoftBank means SoftBank Group, the investment group, rather than its separately listed telecom subsidiary.
An existential threat means a material threat to continued operation or solvency; actual liquidation is not required.

Massive guidance changes means substantial revisions to published financial expectations at multiple large counterparties, explicitly attributable to OpenAI's collapse. No numerical cutoff is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: After a documented OpenAI collapse, evidence establishes both a material threat to SoftBank Group's continued existence and substantial attributable guidance revisions at multiple major counterparties.
criteria.contradiction_condition: After collapse and resolution of the relevant exposures, comprehensive records establish that SoftBank Group faced no material survival threat or that the predicted substantial guidance revisions did not occur.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A documented OpenAI collapse, followed by SoftBank Group solvency evidence and attributable guidance revisions at major counterparties.
